Container.Name: discord-mcp
Container.Overview: Your Discord account for AI agents over MCP, on your tailnet through the host's Tailscale plugin. Build discord-mcp:local from the source checkout, then run docker network create discord-mcp. Keep loopback publishing. After starting, run tailscale serve --bg --https=6443 http://127.0.0.1:6480 and open the HTTPS origin configured in DISCORD_MCP_URL. See docs/self-hosting.md.
Container.Requires: The host Tailscale plugin, MagicDNS and HTTPS certificates, a local image named discord-mcp:local, and a Docker network named discord-mcp.

Config.Name: DISCORD_MCP_URL
Config.Description: Tailscale Serve origin, for example https://tower.example-tailnet.ts.net:6443. Include the port and no path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and generated secrets. Back up together and keep private.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root user ID that runs the app and owns its files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the app and its files.

Config.Name: KEY_PEPPER
Config.Description: Optional override, base64 of 32 bytes. Leave empty to generate into /data/secrets/key-pepper.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional override. Leave empty to generate into /data/secrets/auth-secret.
